title: Apply shared MakeMe rules per entry

intentCoverage.report:
## Dough Intent Coverage: SEED-307#apply-shared-makeme-rules-per-entry

**Outcome: Caught.** The maintained public-command assertion detects omission of an enabled index-only test source.

Story and checked revision: `.planning/seeds/SEED-307-shared-test-pattern-rules.md#apply-shared-makeme-rules-per-entry` at `703fc242c84631550a54061cfd53ac8163f10da2`. The selected promise is that post-change refactoring resolves staged test sources even when the working tree reverses the staged edit and its diff against HEAD is empty. This validates the caller's suggested target; no target or command change was needed.

Fault: in `src/skills/dough-execute-plan/scripts/consumer-trace-terms.mjs:125`, inside `repositoryChangePaths`, replace only `staged: between(base, true)` with `staged: []`. Worktree, untracked and committed collection, fixtures and assertions remain intact. This models a detector that silently omits the cached/index layer.

Maintained proof: `tests/makeme-changed-scope.test.mjs`, test “changed scope includes index-only, working-tree and untracked sources without a folder-prefix shortcut”. Its independent `answer.files` assertion at line 58 expects `enabled/staged.spec.ts` alongside the unstaged and newline-named untracked sources. The fixture is arranged through the shared MakeMe location/repository API; staging and the worktree reversal occur explicitly at the test call site.

The same focused test command ran for baseline, fault and restoration, with separate per-run timing/outcome destinations:

```sh
env PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH OPEN_DOUGH_TEST_TIMES=/tmp/seed307-intent-baseline-times OPEN_DOUGH_TEST_OUTCOMES=/tmp/seed307-intent-baseline-outcomes npm test -- tests/makeme-changed-scope.test.mjs
env PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH OPEN_DOUGH_TEST_TIMES=/tmp/seed307-intent-fault-times OPEN_DOUGH_TEST_OUTCOMES=/tmp/seed307-intent-fault-outcomes npm test -- tests/makeme-changed-scope.test.mjs
env PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH OPEN_DOUGH_TEST_TIMES=/tmp/seed307-intent-restored-times OPEN_DOUGH_TEST_OUTCOMES=/tmp/seed307-intent-restored-outcomes npm test -- tests/makeme-changed-scope.test.mjs
```

- Baseline: exit 0, maintained scope file passed; runner job runtime 5.6 seconds.
- Fault: exit 1 at the named `answer.files` assertion. Its actual list retained the unstaged and untracked sources but omitted `enabled/staged.spec.ts`; runner job runtime 6.4 seconds.
- Restored: source bytes match the saved original, Git porcelain status matches the original empty state, and the same command passed with exit 0; runner job runtime 3.2 seconds.

Independent wrong-behavior observation: a separate MakeMe-built fixture enabled only `enabled/staged.spec.ts`. The witness staged a changed value, restored the working file to its original bytes, and independently verified an empty HEAD-to-worktree diff plus a cached diff naming that source. The public changed-MakeMe command selected it before the fault. With the one fault, that same precondition yielded exit 0 but `status: "not-selected"`, `files: []` and `changedPaths: []`. After restoration the witness selected the staged source again. This observes the promised behavior going wrong, rather than merely observing execution of the mutated collector.

The isolated scratch worktree was created at the checked revision and began clean. No npm installation or native session was required. Automatic restoration was arranged before mutation; all commands reached terminal results. After the restored pass and byte/status comparisons, the clean scratch worktree and its own temporary branch were removed. The coordinator's execution checkout was not edited.

**Next proof action:** retain the maintained staged/worktree-cancellation assertion in default proof. This observed path needs no assertion strengthening or new test. The finding is limited to this one cached-layer omission; it does not establish protection for the entire story.

Prior disposition: `SEED-307#run-makeme-harness-once` addresses duplicate default harness execution. That existing suite-cost correction is separate from this caught staged-scope fault; this probe creates no new repair or routing decision. Cursor native behavior remains unverified under the execution-only waiver; no Cursor/native probe was performed.

Evidence retained outside checkout cleanup: `/tmp/seed307-intent-fault.patch`, `/tmp/seed307-intent-fault.log`, `/tmp/seed307-intent-witness-{baseline,fault,restored}.json`, and `/tmp/seed307-intent-{baseline,fault,restored}-{times,outcomes}`. The finished report is saved verbatim at `/tmp/seed307-intent-coverage-report.md` for the caller's disposition and durable Done record.

- **Test runtime — measured:** 15.2 seconds total for the three maintained runner jobs (5.6 baseline + 6.4 fault + 3.2 restored), from the runner's recorded job-duration files. This excludes scratch setup and separate witnesses.
- **Human effort — unavailable:** no separate human-effort measurement was collected for this probe.
- **Agent effort — unavailable:** no separate token or active-work meter was available; invocation elapsed below measures wall time, not agent effort.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 347322 ms (measured), from 1794403410134 to 1794403757456 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

## Wrap-up disposition

Checked revision: `703fc242c84631550a54061cfd53ac8163f10da2`. The maintained public files assertion caught the independently observed omission of an index-only enabled test. Baseline, one-fault observation, exact restoration and restored passing proof are complete. Retain that assertion and its default registration; this scratch fault identifies no actual delivered defect and requires no test repair or new follow-up. Current closure edits are documentation and records only, so the checked runtime and assertion remain applicable.

The existing ready correction `SEED-307#run-makeme-harness-once` is queued first through the installed backlog command. It preserves the direct harness controls and explicit wrapper while removing duplicate default execution; it is separate from this caught staged-layer fault. No coverage priority exception or product decision is required. Cursor native behavior remains unverified under the execution-only waiver.
